original_test_intent: Force the approved LED mode for a bounded observation window, prove the intended indicators behave accordingly, then release OEM control and confirm original platform-driven indication resumes.
original_method: Master uses OEM 0x30/0x23 0x03 for all-LED blink and documents 0x00 release; review retains it but separates vendor response validation from LED-state acceptance.
manual_activity: Owner approves the all-LED impact and duration, validates observation/readback and guarantees a release/recovery path that does not mask real fault indication.
required_inputs: Current LED policy and active faults
safety_requirements: Do not assume 0x03 is safe on every platform
Preserve active fault and LED baseline
Validate response and visible/readback state separately
Do not reset BMC or retry blindly
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, firmware, LED policy and fault state
Present mode/scope/duration and release for confirmation
Observe or read back actual LED state
engineer_actions: Own operator-visibility risk and failed-release recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete and unsafe: fixed all-blink over insecure SSH has no confirmation, observation or release; generic LAN output is unrelated.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval, use protected `ipmitool raw 0x30 0x23 <approved-mode>`, verify actual LEDs, then send the vendor-approved release value 0x00 and verify policy recovery.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The original 0x03 test value, 0x00 release semantics and 10/5 timing remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the platform-driven LED baseline, apply one approved bounded mode, validate response and physical/readback behavior independently, then release and verify restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds duration, behavioral oracle and mandatory release without changing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Vendor ID proves endpoint identity, not LED function; response success without observation and release is incomplete coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Forced all-LED states can hide or imitate fault indications and mislead operators if release fails.

project_override_considerations: A vendor UI/API is equivalent only if it controls the same LED scope/mode and proves observation plus release; untested raw coverage must be recorded.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Procedure changes all LEDs, but Criteria check only Vendor ID. DeepSeek repeats a fixed write without behavioral or restore evidence and uses insecure access.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The control modes and release intent are identifiable. Platform scope, observation and approval are execution inputs, not a permanent review blocker.

review_improvement: Separates endpoint identity from LED behavior and makes bounded duration plus release/restoration mandatory.
independent_technical_reasoning: LED control is validated at the indicator, not solely in an OEM response. Because 0x03 overrides all LEDs, its largest risk is operator deception rather than hardware damage. A complete test must prove the commanded display and then prove control returns to the original fault/status policy.
